debug.title: Debug
debug.description: Enable before sign-in for setup diagnostics. Save and restart the child bridge for camera logging. Turn off after testing.

account.title: Lollipop account
account.description: Use Sign in / reconnect above, then Save.

password.title: Password (headless setup only)
password.description: Saved in config.json. Interactive sign-in avoids storing it and supports email codes.

sessionToken.title: Session token (headless setup only)
sessionToken.description: Saved in config.json. Leave empty with interactive sign-in.

enableSoundMachine.title: Music switch
enableSoundMachine.description: Play or pause the sound selected in the Lollipop app. Requires MQTT.

unbridge.title: Pair camera separately
unbridge.description: Publish as an external accessory. Leave off to keep cameras on the child bridge.

contactSensors.title: Use contact sensors
contactSensors.description: Present events as contact sensors instead of motion sensors.

enableCryingDetectionSensor.title: Crying sensor
enableCryingDetectionSensor.description: Configure crying detection in the Lollipop app.

enableCrossingDetectionSensor.title: Crossing sensor
enableCrossingDetectionSensor.description: Configure barrier crossing in the Lollipop app.

enableNoiseSensor.title: Noise sensor
enableNoiseSensor.description: Configure noise alerts in the Lollipop app.

lollipops.title: Camera overrides or manual cameras
lollipops.description: Optional account overrides; without an account, enter manual cameras here.

name.title: HomeKit name
name.description: Can also select a matching account camera.

accountCameraName.title: Camera name in Lollipop app
accountCameraName.description: Optional selector for an account-camera override.

enabled.title: Enable this camera
enabled.description: Turn off to exclude the selected account camera.

cameraId.title: Camera ID (pairing ID)
cameraId.description: Optional account selector; required with IP for manual video. Not the hardware serial or hashed path.

rtspUsername.title: RTSP username
rtspUsername.description: Used with a camera ID, not with a complete RTSP URL.

rtspUrl.title: Authenticated RTSP URL
rtspUrl.description: Optional complete URL. Manual video-only mode has no MQTT controls or sensors.

ip.title: Camera IP or hostname
ip.description: Manual setup only. No port or path; automatic account setup supplies the address.

enableSoundMachine.title: Music switch
enableSoundMachine.description: Play or pause the sound selected in the Lollipop app. Requires MQTT.

unbridge.title: Pair camera separately
unbridge.description: Publish as an external accessory. Leave off to keep cameras on the child bridge.

contactSensors.title: Use contact sensors
contactSensors.description: Present events as contact sensors instead of motion sensors.

enableCryingDetectionSensor.title: Crying sensor
enableCryingDetectionSensor.description: Configure crying detection in the Lollipop app.

enableCrossingDetectionSensor.title: Crossing sensor
enableCrossingDetectionSensor.description: Configure barrier crossing in the Lollipop app.

enableNoiseSensor.title: Noise sensor
enableNoiseSensor.description: Configure noise alerts in the Lollipop app.

hksv.title: Legacy experimental HKSV
hksv.description: Unavailable in account and authenticated manual video modes.
